name: Iced Caramel Macchiato
flavor_notes: A popular chilled coffee drink featuring Nespresso espresso, milk, and a sweet caramel drizzle, layered for a classic macchiato look.
barista_note: Pour espresso directly over ice to preserve the temperature boundary and prevent watery dilution.

preparations.roast_note: Bold, roasty profile with low acidity to punch through sweet syrups and cream.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Forty-Six or Equator Mocha Java

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: In your serving glass, combine Caramel Syrup.

Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it directly over the syrups and spices; stir or whisk with a handheld frother until completely dissolved.
Fill the glass with plenty of ice cubes.
Pour Milk over the ice; stir gently to combine and watch the layers swirl.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo Double Espresso Scuro pod

steps: Brew Double Espresso Scuro into the glass.

preparations.roast_note: Bold, roasty profile with low acidity to punch through sweet syrups and cream.
preparations.tested_with: Medaglia d'Oro or Café Bustelo Instant Espresso
steps: In your serving glass, combine Caramel Syrup.
Dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso in 2 oz (60 ml) hot water directly over the syrups and spices; stir until completely dissolved.
Fill the glass with plenty of ice cubes.
Pour Milk over the ice; stir gently to combine and watch the layers swirl.
